description: This Java source file defines the 'ModifyAttributes' class, which represents a command for modifying all attributes of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and provides getters and serialization logic for the command.

classes.name: ModifyAttributes
classes.description: Immutable command class for modifying all attributes of a 'Thing'. It encapsulates attribute data, the target 'Thing' ID, and headers, providing serialization and deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ModifyAttributes command for a specific ThingId and Attributes, with headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyAttributes command from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing necessary fields.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the Attributes object to be used for modification.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the target Thing entity.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON Pointer path to the attributes resource.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the attributes as a JSON value, considering schema version.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes command data into JSON for sending.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command with specified headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization (returns false).
